# CharacterClassInfo

[API index](../index.md)

A resolved native character class. Id is the stable metadata ID; Name is localized.

## Ascendancy

```typescript
readonly Ascendancy?: AscendancyInfo | null;
```

Null means the character is known to have no ascendancy selected.

**@keywords**

character, ascendancy, specialization, selection

## Id

```typescript
readonly Id: string;
```

Stable native metadata identifier.
Compare with CharacterClass constants instead of the display name.

**@keywords**

character, class, identifier, condition

## Name

```typescript
readonly Name: string;
```

Localized class display name.
Separate from the player's chosen PlayerName; use Id for conditions.

**@keywords**

character, class, display, name
